description: A counter incremented once per iteration alongside an unconditional buf[n] write establishes that the written prefix 1..n is dense, so a post-loop n >= 1 guard admits buf[1]. The invariant stops at the last written slot (buf[n+1] stays optional) and every write outside the paired pattern dissolves it: a conditional write, a step of two, a counter seeded above zero, a raise of the counter after the loop, and a second write into the sequence each leave buf[1] optional because the count and the writes can then disagree.
